trailhead.label: The car park by the Rifugio Palafavera, near Pecòl, the sheet’s start

cautions: About 50 m by the SP251 at the Palafavera car park: keep your dog on a short lead there.
Gravel forest road with loose stones and cross drains: watch your dog’s paws.
Cows graze the Malga Pioda pastures in summer: keep a short lead and give them room.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Pecòl to Malga Pioda: Da Pecòl a Malga Pioda, andata e ritorno
textIt.The car park by the Rifugio Palafavera,: Il parcheggio presso il Rifugio Palafavera, vicino a Pecòl, partenza della scheda
textIt.About 50 m by the SP251 at the Palafaver: Circa 50 m lungo la SP251 al parcheggio di Palafavera: lì tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
textIt.Gravel forest road with loose stones and: Strada forestale sterrata con sassi smossi e canalette trasversali: attenzione alle zampe del cane.
textIt.Cows graze the Malga Pioda pastures in s: D’estate le mucche pascolano a Malga Pioda: guinzaglio corto e lascia loro spazio.
